use: Original transparent character artwork, visually animated with Motion; not rigged 3D models.

prompts.hippo: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent hero character for an interactive 3D artist portfolio. Create ONE original high-end animated-feature-quality 3D animal character, fully isolated on a genuinely transparent background, no ground, no floor shadow, no scenery, no text, no labels, no watermark. Entire character visible with 10 percent transparent margin on all sides. Square canvas. Soft studio key light from upper left, large soft fill, delicate rim, beautifully detailed PBR surfaces, charming emotional eyes. Camera three-quarter front at eye level, full-body, focal length 70mm. Keep silhouette bold and toy-like, upscale art direction and sophisticated color. Subject: an exuberant baby hippopotamus with blue-gray skin, small round ears with warm pink inner ears, large rounded muzzle, tiny nostrils, huge open-mouth delighted smile with two cute lower teeth and rosy tongue. Short chunky legs spread playfully in a floating mid-leap pose, belly slightly turned to camera, head looking at viewer. Irregular soft skin folds and subtle pores, little rounded tail. Adorable rather than realistic or scary, generous rotund proportions. Skin is powder-blue/slate, nails warm ivory. Nothing else in image.
